description: Main source file for a Zephyr-based userspace thread protected memory example, involving multiple threads for encryption, processing, and communication, with shared memory and synchronization primitives.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Initializes memory partitions, creates and starts encryption, processing, and communication threads, and sets up shared memory and synchronization.

methods.name: enc
methods.description: Encryption thread function that processes shared input buffer, encrypts data, and places it into output buffer.

methods.name: pt
methods.description: Processing thread function that sends messages to the encryption thread.

methods.name: ct
methods.description: Communication thread that receives encrypted messages and prints them.
